description: Add verdict-check enforcement to aidr_commit_gateway integration. Must query mcp_server_registry for verdict via write_service before forwarding commits. MUST NOT forward CAUTION_LIMITED or HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED without explicit override flag. Must include injection_resilience score in commit payload. Uses write_service at 127.0.0.1:8772 for verdict lookup. No direct DB access. Follows inter-daemon communication rules per spec section 5.
